placeholders.Name: the `name` row of MORTIS.md
placeholders.Aggregate: an aggregate root's type name, singular PascalCase
placeholders.Plural: the aggregate's folder name, plural PascalCase

aggregate_files.description: Files a project adds per aggregate. Every file in these folders must match one pattern; verify.sh fails on any other file there.

always_allowed.description: Paths a project may add at any time. A file outside the manifest, the aggregate folders and these patterns is an extra file and fails verify.sh.

option_changes.description: Existing files an option not built yet changes; the option's page says how.

contexts: every example file: a Contexts/{Context} segment in its path and namespace
